name: dr-andreas-eisele
description: Plugins from the Neuro AI Fluency program by Dr.-Ing. Andreas Eisele — working with agentic AI in a way that is easy on attention and focus.

plugins.name: neuro-ai-fluency
plugins.description: Adapts Claude to how you work: a personal, neuro-friendly output style from a few clickable questions and A/B comparisons from your own sessions, and a latency report that turns your own waiting times into three tiers for what to do while Claude works.

plugins.name: tab-clock
plugins.description: Shows in the terminal tab whether Claude is working, waiting for you, or done — with a running clock.

plugins.name: review-effort
plugins.description: Puts the reading time on top of every longer Claude answer, e.g. "🧠 Review Effort: ~3 min". You see at a glance whether an answer is a quick look or needs a proper review slot. An analysis of your own sessions shows how much time goes into reading per day and how many sessions in parallel pay off.
